item.title: Language Specification
item.description: Intro Quick Script, (Mainly stylized as "quickscript,") is a statically-typed, compiled and interpreted scripting language. Quick Script is compiled into an intermediate representation format and then executed by a virtual machine. The intention of quickscript is to provide a scripting language that is OS and CPU-architecture independent while keeping type-safety and static typing with the intention of preserving fast execution speeds. The real, base, intention of this language is to serve as a learning exercise in implementing a compiler, an IR format, an interpreter and creating a standard library in a low level language (C++.
